name: The Night Window
summary: A performance identity that pairs a forceful title with a quiet programme readers can use before the lights go down.

typography.usage: Performance title and short front-cover statements.
Programme sequence, contextual notes and credits.

recognitionRules: Use Impact for the performance title and Georgia for programme reading.
Keep cast, sequence and contextual notes in distinct text sections.
Give credits a clear hierarchy rather than shrinking them into a decorative footer.
Retain monochrome print legibility in folded formats.
Use burgundy programme labels with the black condensed title; retain the warm-paper supporting panels.

principles: Make the invitation warm and the practical details exact.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: A window opens. Take your seat and follow the evening.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid speaking for an entire community or implying confirmed attendance.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Come for the part that interests you; here is what to expect.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use THE NIGHT WINDOW as a narrow stacked Impact wordmark with one vertical gap between words. Avoid a literal window illustration.
invariants: Use Impact for the performance title and Georgia for programme reading.
Keep cast, sequence and contextual notes in distinct text sections.
Give credits a clear hierarchy rather than shrinking them into a decorative footer.
adaptations: A poster emphasizes title and time; a playbill expands sequence and credits.
Keep essential programme information readable in dim light.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Impact is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Georgia is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
